—
T/N (eliiizabeth): The title “凤娇鸾” literally translates to “Phoenix Delicate Luan.” 凤 (Phoenix) refers to a symbol of the Empress or a noblewoman, while 鸾 (Luan) is a mythological bird often paired with the phoenix, representing harmony, virtue, and high status. For this novel title, I translated it in a more figurative and contextually appropriate sense as:
“Elegant Birds of the Palace.”

Except… this fiancée of his seemed a little… unusual.
When enemies provoked them, she flawlessly framed them with teary eyes, embodying the essence of a white lotus: “Don’t blame him… it’s all my fault…”
When his family bullied him, she beat every last one of them bloody, tossing a million spirit stones at their feet: “One million—now get lost and leave Pei Du alone.”
And when he lay battered and covered in filth, she pressed a soft kiss to his wounds, her voice sweet as honey: “Do you like it?”

World One, Youth Campus Arc (newbie task, all students)
The transfer student heroine arrived and seized the female side character’s position as the top student in the school, so the female side character harbored resentment.
The female side character discovered by chance that the heroine liked the male lead, so she moved first, using the power of the elders to gain the status of “fiancée” and preparing at any moment to pin the label of husband-stealer on the heroine.

But Song Fu stared silently at the male lead, who enthusiastically picked out an engagement ring and even wanted to book the wedding venue ahead of time.
Was something wrong here?
The male lead noticed her speechless gaze and blustered harshly but inwardly weak: “If you dare to start something and not finish it, you’re done for!”
World Two, Online Game Arc (male lead top spender, Song Fu ordinary college student)
In a massively popular online game, the male and female leads were a bickering pair of happy enemies. The male lead topped the rankings as the biggest spender, and the female side character cozied up to him for his money. Someone relayed the female side character’s words to the male lead. He did not care what she thought of him and directly dissolved their in-game marriage, while also demanding she dismantle the items he had given her back then. If she did not, she had to pay him back.
Unexpectedly, just as the male lead’s chubby photos leaked, Song Fu received a barrage of calls.
Male lead: “I’m a total hunk now! Really, I have abs—want to see?”
Song Fu: “…No thanks.”
Male lead: “You do want to see! Let’s video!”
World Three, Overbearing CEO Arc (male lead CEO)
The marriage contract between the male lead and the female side character stemmed from family interests and the female side character’s one-sided infatuation.
This relatively stable state shattered with the arrival of the delicate little white flower heroine. The male lead, long plagued by insomnia, discovered he could actually sleep soundly by her side!
As the two gradually grew close, living and traveling together, the female side character grew greatly dissatisfied. She hurled vicious words at the heroine and slapped her with a check, even causing a scene at the company.
In the end, the male lead, unable to tolerate it anymore, realized the heroine’s importance and proposed breaking the engagement.
However, Song Fu now had to ask: what was up with this male lead currently clinging to her and sleeping like a dead pig?!
What happened to the promised insomnia?
The male lead got knocked on the forehead and sleepily opened his eyes: “You’re hungry? I’ll go make food.”
